title: Two unrelated NPCs are both named 'Ness' (one flagged in Thornwold bearings as living in a hut past the black thorn, a different one actually met running the shift-tally at Cinderhall's head-frame) — briefly made me think I'd found the Thornwold NPC in the wrong hold.
